lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man har har naam dhiaai ||
lines.translation: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਹਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਆਗੈ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam sahaaee sadaa sa(n)g aagai lae chhadaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Naam is your Companion; it shall always be with you. It shall save you in the world hereafter. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਕਵਨੈ ਆਵਹਿ ਕਾਮਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: duneeaa keeaa vadiaaeeaa kavanai aavahi kaam ||
lines.translation: What good is worldly greatness?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਸਭੁ ਫਿਕਾ ਜਾਤੋ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਨਿਦਾਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa kaa ra(n)g sabh phikaa jaato binas nidaan ||
lines.translation: All the pleasures of Maya are tasteless and insipid. In the end, they shall all fade away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਸੋ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai hiradai har vasai so pooraa paradhaan ||2||
lines.translation: Perfectly fulfilled and supremely acclaimed is the one, in whose heart the Lord abides. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਹੋਹੁ ਰੇਣੁਕਾ ਅਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhoo kee hohu renukaa apanaa aap tiaag ||
lines.translation: Become the dust of the Saints; renounce your selfishness and conceit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਪਾਵ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਸਗਲ ਛਡਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: upaav siaanap sagal chhad gur kee charanee laag ||
lines.translation: Give up all your schemes and your clever mental tricks, and fall at the Feet of the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਗੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tisahi paraapat ratan hoi jis masatak hovai bhaag ||3||
lines.translation: He alone receives the Jewel, upon whose forehead such wondrous destiny is written. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੈ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tisai paraapat bhaaeeho jis devai prabh aap ||
lines.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, it is received only when God Himself bestows it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਾਪੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kee sevaa so kare jis binasai haumai taap ||
lines.translation: People serve the True Guru only when the fever of egotism has been eradicated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥੪॥੮॥੭੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kau gur bhetiaa binase sagal sa(n)taap ||4||8||78||
lines.translation: Nanak has met the Guru; all his sufferings have come to an end. ||4||8||78||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਪਛਾਣੂ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਇਕੋ ਰਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik pachhaanoo jee kaa iko rakhanahaar ||
lines.translation: The One is the Knower of all beings; He alone is our Savior.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਸ ਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਆਸਰਾ ਇਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikas kaa man aasaraa iko praan adhaar ||
lines.translation: The One is the Support of the mind; the One is the Support of the breath of life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tis saranaaee sadaa sukh paarabraham karataar ||1||
lines.translation: In His Sanctuary there is eternal peace. He is the Supreme Lord God, the Creator. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਉਪਾਵ ਤਿਆਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mere sagal upaav tiaag ||
lines.translation: O my mind, give up all these efforts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਨਿਤ ਇਕਸੁ ਕੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa aaraadh nit ikas kee liv laag ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Dwell upon the Perfect Guru each day, and attach yourself to the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕੋ ਭਾਈ ਮਿਤੁ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੋ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: iko bhaaee mit ik iko maat pitaa ||
lines.translation: The One is my Brother, the One is my Friend. The One is my Mother and Father.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਸ ਕੀ ਮਨਿ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦਿਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikas kee man tek hai jin jeeu pi(n)d ditaa ||
lines.translation: The One is the Support of the mind; He has given us body and soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਤਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: so prabh manahu na visarai jin sabh kichh vas keetaa ||2||
lines.translation: May I never forget God from my mind; He holds all in the Power of His Hands. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar iko baahar iko thaan thana(n)tar aap ||
lines.translation: The One is within the home of the self, and the One is outside as well. He Himself is in all places and interspaces.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਏ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh jin keee aath pahar tis jaap ||
lines.translation: Meditate twenty-four hours a day on the One who created all beings and creatures.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਸੁ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ikas setee ratiaa na hovee sog sa(n)taap ||3||
lines.translation: Attuned to the Love of the One, there is no sorrow or suffering. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: paarabraham prabh ek hai doojaa naahee koi ||
lines.translation: There is only the One Supreme Lord God; there is no other at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d sabh tis kaa jo tis bhaavai s hoi ||
lines.translation: Soul and body all belong to Him; whatever pleases His Will comes to pass.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਭਇਆ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੯॥੭੯॥
lines.transliteration: gur poorai pooraa bhaiaa jap naanak sachaa soi ||4||9||79||
lines.translation: Through the Perfect Guru, one becomes perfect; O Nanak, meditate on the True One. ||4||9||79||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪਰਧਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinaa satigur siu chit laaiaa se poore paradhaan ||
lines.translation: Those who focus their consciousness on the True Guru are perfectly fulfilled and famous.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਤਿਨ ਉਪਜੈ ਮਨਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kau aap daiaal hoi tin upajai man giaan ||
lines.translation: Spiritual wisdom wells up in the minds of those unto whom the Lord Himself shows Mercy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jin kau masatak likhiaa tin paaiaa har naam ||1||
lines.translation: Those who have such destiny written upon their foreheads obtain the Name of the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mere eko naam dhiaai ||
lines.translation: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਸੁਖ ਊਪਜਹਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab sukhaa sukh oopajahi daragah paidhaa jaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The happiness of all happiness shall well up, and in the Court of the Lord, you shall be dressed in robes of honor. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਗਇਆ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran kaa bhau gaiaa bhaau bhagat gopaal ||
lines.translation: The fear of death and rebirth is removed by performing loving devotional service to the Lord of the World.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)gat niramalaa aap kare pratipaal ||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one becomes immaculate and pure; the Lord Himself takes care of such a one.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran kee mal kateeai gur darasan dekh nihaal ||2||
lines.translation: The filth of birth and death is washed away, and one is uplifted, beholding the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: thaan thana(n)tar rav rahiaa paarabraham prabh soi ||
lines.translation: The Supreme Lord God is pervading all places and interspaces.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhanaa daataa ek hai doojaa naahee koi ||
lines.translation: The One is the Giver of all-there is no other at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਕੀਤਾ ਲੋੜੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tis saranaaee chhuteeai keetaa loRe s hoi ||3||
lines.translation: In His Sanctuary, one is saved. Whatever He wishes, comes to pass. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪਰਧਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin man vasiaa paarabraham se poore paradhaan ||
lines.translation: Perfectly fulfilled and famous are those, in whose minds the Supreme Lord God abides.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੀ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਭਈ ਜਹਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin kee sobhaa niramalee paragat bhaee jahaan ||
lines.translation: Their reputation is spotless and pure; they are famous all over the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੮੦॥
lines.transliteration: jinee meraa prabh dhiaaiaa naanak tin kurabaan ||4||10||80||
lines.translation: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who meditate on my God. ||4||10||80||
